welcome.slide1Body: Meet people from the Turkic world near you, and find where you belong.
welcome.slide2Body: Groups for your city, culture and interests, with real meetups on the calendar.
welcome.slide3Body: Smart matching suggests people who share your interests, values and plans, for friendship, romance, business or mentorship, and shows why you'd click.

welcome.slide4Body: Verified members, plans shared with someone you trust, your choice of how much location to show, and block or report anytime.

about.title: About Turkic Circles
about.body: Turkic Circles is a connections app for the Turkic and Turkic-adjacent diaspora — friendship, romance, business, and mentorship, all in one community rather than four separate products.

guidelines.title: Community guidelines
guidelines.body: Be respectful, be honest about who you are, and treat every conversation the way you'd want to be treated. Harassment, hate speech, and impersonation are never allowed and will result in account action.

help.title: Help & support
help.body: Questions, problems or feedback? Email us at unturkk@gmail.com and we'll get back to you as soon as we can. To report someone, open their profile or the Safety Center.

privacy.title: Data & privacy
privacy.body: Your heritage, how important faith is to you, and (for romantic connections) your gender and who you want to meet are only used for matching with your explicit consent, which you can withdraw any time in Edit profile. Faith, gender and who you want to meet are never shown to other members. The Privacy Policy has the details.
